DeepFRI.note: CNN-LM seq-only, 65/81 valid MF terms in vocab; uncovered terms set to 0

kNN_ESM2.note: k=5 cosine, L30 ESM-2, isoform-level retrieval

PRISM_zero_shot.note: v15d trained on 18 GO-BP terms, zero-shot transfer to 82 MF terms

D0_ESM2_MLP.note: ESM-2 L30 frozen + MLP Dense(256)→BN→Drop(0.3)→Dense(128)→Drop(0.2)→sigmoid, focal γ=2, 5-seed

D1_FineTuned_MLP.note: ESM-2 L30 fine-tuned (GO-MF supervised) + MLP Dense(256)→BN→Drop(0.3)→Dense(128)→Drop(0.2)→sigmoid, focal γ=2, 5-seed

v17f_star.note: delta(L30-L15) concat L30 → Dense(256)→BN→Drop(0.2)→Dense(128)→sigmoid, focal γ=2, 5-seed ensemble

Domain_LR.note: Pfam domain features + LogisticRegression; gene-level annotation transfer
